senses.gloss: (b. h.; √או , v. אוי I; cmp. אָפַץ; v. חוּץ a. חָצָה) to be pressed (to press, hurry).—Part. אוֹצֶה, pl. אוֹצִין (as from אצה, v. חוּץ, חוּל) squeezed in.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 5</cite> <he>א׳ חבור</he> (Var. <cite ref="E00263"><he>הוצין</he></cite>) when they are squeezed in (tight), they are considered as connected for levitical purposes.
